💾 Save Design

Updating existing design:
⚠ Name changed from —. Auto-ticked Save as a new copy so the original stays intact. Un-tick to rename in place instead.
💾 Save to Computer writes a .spdesign.json download and a copy in this browser's My Designs (no cloud). ☁ Save to Cloud syncs to your account so the design follows you across devices (no file download).

Bulk Edit

Leave the checkbox off to keep each row's existing date. Check it with a blank date to clear the shot date (falls back to upload date).

Manage Categories

Add, rename, or delete categories. Deleting a category leaves its images in place — they move to "Uncategorized".

Manage Tags

Add, rename, delete, or apply a tag across the library. Renaming to an existing tag merges them.

Apply tag to images

Check images to give them this tag; uncheck to remove it. Filter by name or category to narrow the list.

Manage size presets

Add custom canvas sizes and choose which dropdown (Social / Web) they appear under. Built-in sizes can't be edited. Saved per-browser on this device.

🪄 Refine Background Removal

Live preview — adjust sliders, then click Apply.
0
Negative keeps more detail (fur, hair, soft edges). Positive trims halos and background bleed. ±50 was the old cap — ±100 gives full control for stubborn cases.
30
0 = hard binary edges. Higher = softer feathered transition. Most images look best at 5–25; 100 is very fuzzy and tends to keep background bleed.

🎨 Edit Brand Palette

These colors are used when you click a brand recolor button on an SVG clip art layer. Colors map to the SVG's swatches by brightness — darkest original color picks up the darkest brand color, lightest picks up lightest, etc. So include both dark and light variants for best results.
Click a swatch to recolor it · × removes · drag to reorder isn't supported (yet) — but you can always Reset and rebuild.

🎨 Clip Art Browser

Open-source illustrations from Noto Emoji, Twemoji, Fluent Emoji / Fluent Color, OpenMoji, Emojione, fxemoji, Flat Color Icons, and Streamline — all free for commercial use (Apache 2.0 / CC‑BY / MIT). Searched via the Iconify aggregator. Tip: if a phrase returns nothing, try a shorter term — "cap" instead of "baseball cap", "hat" instead of "top hat".
